# pdf.js (vendored)

Mozilla's PDF.js, version 3.11.174 (`pdfjs-dist`, legacy build), used to read
the text and picture positions of an uploaded test PDF in the browser.
Loaded only when a PDF is uploaded. Licensed under the Apache License 2.0
(see `LICENSE`).

Files: `legacy/build/pdf.min.js` and `legacy/build/pdf.worker.min.js` from
https://registry.npmjs.org/pdfjs-dist/-/pdfjs-dist-3.11.174.tgz
